```{r libs}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(modelsummary)
library(flextable)
library(performance)   # needed for ICC and R2 rows
```

```{r models, include=FALSE}
# Path is relative to the folder containing this .Rmd (knitting uses that as the working directory)
compliant_trials_demographics <- 
  read_csv("../../data/compliant_trials_demographics.csv")

# Change reference level to Low-Agency
compliant_trials_demographics <- compliant_trials_demographics %>%
  mutate(condition = fct_relevel(condition,
                                 "Low-Agency",
                                 "High-Agency",
                                 "Control"))

compliant_originality_aug <- lmer(
  originality ~ condition +
    (1|object) + (1|submitter_id) + (1|rater_id),
  data = compliant_trials_demographics)
anova(compliant_originality_aug)

compliant_creativity_aug <- lmer(
  creativity ~ condition +
    (1|object) + (1|submitter_id) + (1|rater_id),
  data = compliant_trials_demographics)
anova(compliant_creativity_aug)


compliant_usefulness_aug <- lmer(
  usefulness ~ condition +
    (1|object) + (1|submitter_id) + (1|rater_id),
  data = compliant_trials_demographics)
anova(compliant_usefulness_aug)

augmented_models <- list(
    "Creativity"  = compliant_creativity_aug,
  "Originality" = compliant_originality_aug,
  "Usefulness"  = compliant_usefulness_aug
)
```

## Table A2
Linear Mixed-Effects Models Predicting Subjective Ratings of Creativity, Originality, and Usefulness


```{r}
modelsummary(
  augmented_models,
  output      = "flextable",
  estimate    = "{estimate}{stars}",
  statistic   = "({std.error})",
  stars       = c("*" = .05, "**" = .01, "***" = .001),
  coef_rename = c(
    "(Intercept)"               = "Intercept",
    "conditionHigh-Agency"    = "High-Agency",
    "conditionControl"        = "Control",
    "SD (Intercept rater_id)" = "SD (Rater intercept)",
    "SD (Intercept submitter_id)" = "SD (Submitter intercept)",
    "SD (Intercept object)" = "SD (Object intercept)",
    "SD (Observations)" = "SD (Residual)"
  ),
  gof_map     = c("nobs", "aic", "bic", "icc", "r2.marginal", "r2.conditional")
) %>%
  autofit() %>%
  add_footer_lines(values = "Note: Standard errors in parentheses. The Low-Agency condition is set as the reference level.") %>%
  italic(i = 1, j = 1, part = "footer")


```


## Table A3
Linear Mixed-Effects Model Predicting Similarity to Condition-Object Centroid


```{r}
iriss_doshi <- read_csv("../../data/doshi_centroid_analysis.csv")

iriss_doshi <- iriss_doshi %>%
  mutate(condition = fct_relevel(condition,
                                 "Low-Agency",
                                 "High-Agency",
                                 "Control"))

iriss_doshi_mod <- lmer(similarity_to_cond_obj ~ 
                          condition + 
                          (1|submitter_id) + 
                          (1|object), 
                        data = iriss_doshi)

modelsummary(
  list("Cosine Similarity to Centroid" = iriss_doshi_mod),
  output      = "flextable",
  coef_rename = c(
    "conditionHigh-Agency" = "High-Agency",
    "conditionControl" = "Control",
    "SD (Intercept submitter_id)" = "SD (Submitter intercept)",
    "SD (Intercept object)" = "SD (Object intercept)",
    "SD (Observations)" = "SD (Residual)"
  ),
  stars       = c("***" = 0.001, "**" = 0.01, "*" = 0.05)
) %>%
  autofit() |> 
  add_footer_lines(values = "Note: Standard errors in parentheses. The Low-Agency condition is set as the reference level.") %>%
  italic(i = 1, j = 1, part = "footer")
```
